title: BHMarketer Trustpilot Removal FAQ Generator: Trustpilot Review Removal FAQ, Page FAQ Schema and Eligibility Scoring
description: The BHMarketer Trustpilot Removal FAQ Generator answers questions about the BHMarketer.ai Trustpilot Review Removal Service from a 50-question FAQ database (service overview, review eligibility, turnaround time, ordering and pricing, results and guarantees, support), builds the page FAQ section with one H2, an H3 per question and matching FAQPage JSON-LD, and checks a Trustpilot review against the five reasons Trustpilot accepts when a business reports a review, scoring removal eligibility from 0 to 100 and listing the evidence to include. Includes identical TypeScript (NPM) and Python (PyPI) implementations, a 50-entry FAQ dataset and a 20-case benchmark dataset. Estimates only; Trustpilot makes the final decision. Not affiliated with Trustpilot. Built by BHMarketer.ai.
